  41.01 ^7g_maplist is "boil opium courtfun erbium vorix xoylent go trident catharsis afterslime space-elevator darkzone glowplant silentsiege finalrage implosion fuse geoplanetary techassault dance bromine solarium nexballarena runningmanctf atelier leave_em_behind warfare stormkeep runningman" [""] the list of maps to be cycled among (is autogenerated if empty)
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_allow_frustrating is "0" ["0"] allow impossible maps to be, e.g., voted for and in the maplist (if set to 2, ONLY impossible maps are allowed)
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_allow_hidden is "0" ["0"] allow hidden maps to be, e.g., voted for and in the maplist
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_check_waypoints is "0" ["0"] when 1, maps are skipped if there currently are bots, but the map has no waypoints
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_ignore_sizes is "0" ["0"] when 1, all maps are shown in the map list regardless of player count
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_index is "28" ["0"] this is used internally for saving position in maplist cycle
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_mostrecent is "runningman" [""] contains the name of the maps that were most recently played
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_mostrecent_count is "3" ["3"] number of most recent maps that are blocked from being played again
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_selectrandom is "0" ["0"] if 1, a random map will be chosen as next map - DEPRECATED in favor of g_maplist_shuffle
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_shuffle is "1" ["1"] new randomization method: like selectrandom, but avoid playing the same maps in short succession. This works by taking out the first element and inserting it into g_maplist with a bias to the end of the list
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_sizes_count_bots is "1" ["1"] include the number of bots currently in the server when counting the number of players for size restrictions
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_sizes_count_maxplayers is "1" ["1"] check the player limit when getting the player count so forced spectators don't affect the size restrictions
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_sizes_specparty is "0" ["0"] this fraction of people are expected to only spectate, reduces player count used to select voting GUI maps
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable is "6" ["6"] number of maps that are shown in the map voting at the end of a match, 0 to disable
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_abstain is "0" ["0"] offer a "don't care" option on the voting screen
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_keeptwotime is "15" ["15"] show only 2 options after this amount of time during map vote screen
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_nodetail is "0" ["0"] hide per-map vote counts (to avoid influential first votes)
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_screenshot_dir is "maps levelshots" ["maps levelshots"] where to look for map screenshots
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_suggestions is "2" ["2"] number of maps a player is allowed to suggest for the map voting screen using 'suggestmap'
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_suggestions_override_mostrecent is "0" ["0"] allow players to suggest maps that have been played recently
  41.01 ^7g_maplist_votable_timeout is "30" ["30"] timeout for the map voting; must be below 50 seconds!
